story.title: We started with a single file, and we still work the same way
story.lead: The office was founded in 2012 to serve business owners who found regulatory procedures more complicated than they should be. The principle hasn't changed: a written scope of work, a published timeline, and one point of contact who owns the file from start to finish.
story.paragraph: Today we serve more than twelve sectors, and deal with government entities both electronically and in person. The largest share of our clients return to us for compliance and accounting services after formation — and that's the measure we hold ourselves to.
